item.title: Hungary and Slovakia turn to Brussels over oil transit dispute with Croatia
item.description: Hungary's Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó said the two countries had formally requested Brussels to enforce an EU rule allowing them to purchase Russian crude, but he got an unusually sharp answer from Croatian Economy Minister Ante Šušnjar. item.title: The forint surprised everyone in 2025, while euro savers took a hit
item.description: Many people believe that keeping savings in euros is one of the simplest ways to protect themselves against a weakening Hungarian forint. But 2025 proved to be a rare exception: the forint strengthened, and those who exchanged their money into euros at the beginning of the year often found that by the end of the year their savings were worth less in forints. Continue reading: https://dailynewshungary.com/euro-forint-savings-lost-value/
